root_cause.primary: The bounded-Ray object store fixed the earlier 38.6GB Ray object-store reservation, but it did not make the 4-group DP4/TP1 dLoRA startup envelope fit this 125GB host. Four dLoRA/vLLM engines still initialized concurrently and Ray killed a worker due to host-memory pressure before HTTP readiness.
not_primary: Not a CUDA GPU OOM: all GPUs were released after failure and each GPU was only around 7.4GB while startup was progressing.
Not a remote materialization issue: all 500 adapters were fetched from the true remote endpoint before server launch.
Not a measured dLoRA scheduling or replay result: no replay request was issued.
root_cause.mechanism: With num_groups=4 and TP=1, dLoRA creates four independent Ray/vLLM engine startup paths. Each path loads model/runtime/adapter state; after object-store bounding, the duplicated engine initialization itself is the dominant host-memory pressure. This is a topology memory envelope issue, not a workload trace or metric issue.
root_cause.why_not_patch_core: Fixing DP4/TP1 without reducing engine duplication would require changing dLoRA's core engine initialization or memory-layout behavior. The allowed adaptation boundary is wrapper/env/topology/metadata/replay compatibility, so the next fair step is to test a less duplicative official topology rather than rewriting dLoRA internals.

decision.reason: This is the third closed 4-group startup memory gate. It proves the DP4/TP1 4-GPU topology is not a stable local envelope under wrapper/env-only adaptation on this host, even after swap-space and Ray object-store controls.
next_fair_steps: Run an official dLoRA migration_type=3 gate that still uses all four GPUs but reduces engine duplication: num_groups=2, tensor_parallel_size=2, gpu_ids=0,1,2,3, max_num_seqs=4, max_num_batched_tokens=1024, gpu_memory_utilization=0.92, swap_space_gb=2, bounded Ray object store.
If DP2/TP2 reaches HTTP readiness and completes the 128-request gate, compare its e2e_v3 metrics against the best DP2/TP1 two-GPU gate before choosing the full 4000-request envelope.

If DP2/TP2 also fails before readiness, use the best valid 2-GPU DP2/TP1 envelope for a full 3B migration_type=3 replay and document that 4-GPU dLoRA is infeasible on the current host without core memory-layout changes.
